sample.title: Accounting and Cash Flow Treatment for Leases with Purchase Options
sample.teachingSummary: The right-of-use asset is depreciated over the asset's life, assuming resale at the end of the period. When a lease includes a purchase option, the debt recognized includes both future lease payments and the purchase option price.
sample.workedExample: For “Accounting and Cash Flow Treatment for Leases with”: Reconcile bank to ledger, clear timing items and restrictions, then state available liquidity before the pack goes out.
sample.commonMistake: Reporting the ledger balance as available cash while uncleared items, overdrafts, or restrictions remain untested on “Accounting and Cash Flow Treatment for Leases with”.

sample.title: Accounting for CO2 Emission Quotas: Recognizing Provisions
sample.teachingSummary: Entities emitting more CO2 than their free allowances must recognize a provision for the deficit in the year the emissions occur, reflecting the cost as a production expense.
sample.workedExample: For “Accounting for CO2 Emission Quotas”: Trace the rule to source evidence, name the decision owner, and write the conclusion on the working paper with the judgement that would change the answer.
sample.commonMistake: Restating the rule without evidence, judgement, ownership, or a decision that can be challenged on “Accounting for CO2 Emission Quotas”.
